about_the_game:
Hijong Park's Defender Patrol is a low-poly helicopter combat flight simulator featuring simple but fully interactable cockpit system, playable in both the monitor and Virtual-reality.

The game aims to be a middle ground between serious study flight simulator and arcade action for light observation helicopter, with a simple low poly graphics that resembles the flight simulators frin MS-DOS era.

Features

  • Semi-realistic flight model, which is a lot simpler than real life helicopters but still gives the feeling of riding a helicopter.
  • Directly interact with switches in the cockpit. You don't need to memorize tons of keybinds!
  • Offers 3 different play modes for flight sim enthusiasts:
    1. Flatscreen: play in just simple flat screen monitor with joysticks or Keyboard and mouse. Various snap view functions are available to aid your limited vision.
    2. TrackIR: Use your TrackIR device to quickly look around the cockpit.
    3. VR: Play with VR controllers alone, or mix some joysticks. Various combos are possible.
  • Procedurally Generated scenes and missions offering completely unexpectable encounters during your duty!
  • Equip weapons in each 2 pylons of MD-500MG to destroy things, or carry 4 troops with MD-500E.
  • Encounter various AI units including infantries, MANPADS, stationary turrets, armored cars, tanks, howitzers, and SPAAVs. Kill bad ones, help good ones.
  • Fly with your AI helicopter wingmen to complete missions, and fight with enemy AI helicopters.
  • Use ANVIS for night operations.
  • Out of ammo? Draw your victorious model 10 and keep fighting for your victory.
